o1: Enables protein kinase C binding activity and small GTPase binding activity. Involved in establishment of mitotic spindle localization; gonad development; and polarity specification of anterior/posterior axis. Predicted to be involved in the establishment or maintenance of cell polarity. Is located in P granule and cell cortex. Is extrinsic component of cytoplasmic side of plasma membrane. Is expressed in AB; EMS; P0; Psub1; and excretory cell. Orthologous to several human genes including PARD6B (par-6 family cell polarity regulator beta).
